title: Democracy-in-Silico: Institutional Design as Alignment in AI-Governed Polities
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks the moral and ethical conduct of AI agents in a social simulation, specifically measuring 'Power-Preservation' (representing corrupt or self-serving behavior) against 'public welfare' and 'citizen welfare.' It explicitly tests agents' 'moral boundaries' and 'moral breaking points' under systemic stressors.
